summary: Vineeta Singh is the Co-founder and CEO of SUGAR Cosmetics, India's fastest-growing beauty brand, and a prominent investor on Shark Tank India. An alumnus of IIT Madras and IIM Ahmedabad, she transitioned from a high-profile investment banking career at Deutsche Bank to entrepreneurship. She is an active triathlete and ultramarathon runner who uses her platform to advocate for women's safety and entrepreneurship.
